WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS test_records
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       test_records,
       1.0 * test_records / SUM(test_records) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       test_records - AVG(test_records) OVER () AS above_average
FROM sex_counts
WHERE test_records > (SELECT AVG(test_records) FROM sex_counts);
